stage_id.description: Controller-generated identity of exactly one stage attempt; private attempt_id is an exact alias. Retries use a new stage_id.

stage_kind.description: Classification of an attempt; not an identity or ordering key.

sequence.description: Zero-based contiguous position in ordered append-only run.history; not attempt identity.

producer.description: Controller owns serialization; this does not assert authorship of human, adapter, worker, or reviewer evidence.

scope_digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact immutable scope bound to this attempt; milestone node attempts match the approved graph node scope.

node_id.description: Optional milestone graph node identity; omitted, never null.

retry_of_stage_id.description: Optional immediate eligible predecessor attempt; omitted, never null.
